name: Aiqing Zhongdian
source:
Does every romance have to end in marriage or breakup?
Is a life without marriage or children the key to true happiness?
Whether or not you've ever been in love,
you’ve surely heard countless perspectives on romance.
In this game, you’ll play as a woman who is in a relationship.
When your ex, current partner, and first love each begin to stir your heart,
how will the tangled threads of love shape your destiny?
Step into this trial of love and uncover the ending that truly belongs to you!

[From [url=https://store.stampowered.com/app/3365970]Steam[/url]]
translation:
是不是每一段恋情都必须以结婚或分手告终？
没有婚姻或孩子的生活是真正幸福的关键吗？
无论你是否曾经恋爱过，
你肯定听过无数种关于浪漫的观点。
在这款游戏中，你将扮演一名处于恋爱关系中的女性。
当你的前任、现任伴侣、初恋情人开始触动你的心时，
纠缠不清的爱情之线将如何塑造你的命运？
走进这场爱情的考验，揭开真正属于你的结局！

[来自[url=https://store.stampowered.com/app/3365970]Steam[/url]]
